outline: This course is designed for international students with basic Chinese proficiency, aiming to further enhance their overall listening, speaking, reading, and writing skills. It helps students communicate more confidently and fluently in increasingly complex daily interactions. The course focuses on expanding vocabulary, strengthening sentence structure usage, and improving language comprehension and expression through reading and writing practice. Additionally, aspects of Chinese culture will be integrated to deepen students' understanding and appreciation, broadening and enriching their language learning experience.

flexible_learning.content: The course includes a Chinese-language video assignment. Please submit your video before class in Week 16. During Weeks 17 and 18, you will watch your classmates’ videos, complete peer evaluations, and provide feedback.
flexible_learning.outcome: During the flexible learning period in Weeks 17 and 18, please use the Google Form provided by the instructor to complete the peer evaluations and provide suggestions. Your grade will be based on how thoroughly you complete this activity. Appropriate and valuable feedback will receive a higher score.

notes:
1. The course focuses on Chinese language and culture throughout the semester, aligning with SDG 4: Quality Education.

2. In Week 12 of the course, students practice calligraphy and engage in hands-on activities to experience culture firsthand and appreciate the beauty of character education. This activity also serves as a form of learning assessment and corresponds to the third component of Innovative Character Education, “Exhortation.”
